description: Source code for a Spring MVC controller managing product-related administrative operations such as creating, editing, duplicating, and removing products and images within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling administrative product management functions such as editing, creating, duplicating, and managing product images and categories within the backend of an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: displayProductEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product editing page for a specific product by ID.

methods.name: displayProductCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product creation form.

methods.name: displayProduct
methods.description: Internal method for populating the product form with data for either editing or creating a product.

methods.name: saveProduct
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a product, including validation of inputs and images.

methods.name: duplicateProduct
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing product, copying its properties but ignoring SKU, reviews, and images.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Removes a product image based on its ID via an AJAX POST request.

methods.name: displayAddProductToCategories
methods.description: Displays a page to associate a product with categories.

methods.name: pageProductCategories
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of categories associated with a product for pagination purposes.

methods.name: deleteProductFromCategory
methods.description: Removes a category association from a product via an AJAX POST request.

methods.name: addProductToCategory
methods.description: Adds an association between a product and a category.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu data for views, setting active menu items.
